[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = 7 (Originally) |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]250 |defense = {{Defense}}25% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (2.5) |spawned_by = [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] (Wave 11 onwards) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} ==Description== The '''Packed Ice''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can be only spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Compared to the [[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]], the '''Packed Ice''' had much more health with slower speed. It also had 25% [[defense]] which reduced most forms of damage. Upon its death, the [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] had a chance to spawn the '''Packed Ice''', from wave 11 onwards. ==Appearance== The '''Packed Ice''' has a sky blue skin. It has light blue torso and legs. The '''Packed Ice''' has a hole in its torso, exposing its dark blue heart. It is faceless and slightly larger than the [[Frozen (Frost Invasion)|Frozen]]. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *Use towers with high DPS while being economical in cost, like several Level 2 [[Minigunner]]s or a Level 0 [[Accelerator]], to deal with the '''Packed Ice''' when it initially spawns. *A single Level 5 [[Swarmer]] can easily handle the '''Packed Ice''', despite the fact that it has 25% defense. *You can use a Level 2 [[Pyromancer]] to cut 50% of the '''Packed Ice's''' defense. **Additionally, as with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Packed Ice''' (though normal damage is not doubled). **You can also use other defense dropping towers, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]]. However, these are more expensive and less effective as they only drop 20% defense. *[[Defense]] is ignored by splash damage, meaning that towers and [[units]] that deal splash damage will deal 100% damage if the '''Packed Ice''' is caught in the epicenter. **This makes towers like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] very useful against the '''Packed Ice'''. **Upon collision, [[units]], like the [[Railgun Tank]], will ignore [[defense]] and deal full collision damage towards the '''Packed Ice'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyPackedIce.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Packed Ice''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionPackedIceIconIG.png|'''Packed Ice''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The appearance of the '''Packed Ice''' is similar to the [[Frozen (Frost Invasion)|Frozen]]. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Packed Ice''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Packed Ice''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Packed Ice''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Packed Ice]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **{{Bug}} Has no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bugfix}} '''Packed Ice''' no longer breaks, as it now has health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{FrostInvasion|[[Cold Mist (Frost Invasion)|Cold Mist]]|Wave 5|Packed Ice|Wave 7|[[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Packed Ice}}
